blocks.text: For over 40 years, Rolyan has been the therapist’s choice and most trusted brand when it comes to orthopedic supports and hand therapy tools. Rolyan products are designed with the patient and hand therapist in mind, and occupational therapists, physical therapists, nurses, and other healthcare professionals rely on Rolyan products to assist the elderly and those with disabilities. Rolyan products include therapeutic putty, overhead exercise devices, slings, rigid and soft orthopedic supports, wrist braces, therapeutic and thermoplastic splints, straps, fasteners, and range of motion products. These are the same high quality professional products used in hospitals, clinics, and nursing homes.

items.label: GENTLE SUPPORT FOR NECK STRAIN & ALIGNMENT
items.value: Soft cervical neck brace offers comfortable stabilization for everyday strain, posture correction, or post-op recovery; shaped to follow natural neck curves for balanced support

items.label: LOW-PROFILE 2” HEIGHT WITH UNIVERSAL SIZING
items.value: 2-inch contour fits under the chin for subtle lift; one-size-fits-most adult design fits a wide range of neck sizes for men and women without measuring

items.label: SOFT FOAM DESIGN WITH EASY VELCRO CLOSURE
items.value: Lightweight and flexible brace made from breathable medium-density foam; adjustable hook-and-loop strap ensures a snug yet comfortable fit throughout the day or night

items.label: IDEAL FOR SLEEPING, DAILY USE & TRAVEL
items.value: Use as a neck brace for sleeping, home recovery, travel support, or to promote cervical spine alignment while resting; cream color blends discreetly under clothes

items.label: LATEX-FREE & SKIN-FRIENDLY MATERIALS
items.value: Stockinette cover allows airflow and helps prevent skin irritation; latex-free construction makes it suitable for sensitive users or long-term wear
